title: recipe.toml
description: What a Karni recipe is: a ready-made karni.yaml and when to start from it. Generated by python -m karni_cli.recipes. Never edit it by hand.

RecipeRoute.description: A ``[[routes]]`` entry: a path of the React app and the recipe's page for it.

path.description: The route, as TanStack Router writes it: /cart, /shop/$slug.

page.description: The page that serves it: a file of the recipe's files/frontend/src/, without .tsx (pages/store/cart), whose default export is the page.

public.description: true: a visitor sees the page without signing in (staticData.public). Default: the app's sign-in guard applies.

data.description: More staticData of the route for the recipe's own layout to read, e.g. {area = "store"}. The recipe declares their types (StaticDataRouteOption).

name.description: The recipe's name: its folder's name, or its entry point's. Lowercase letters, digits, - and _. blank is taken by the blank start.

title.description: A short human name, e.g. Online shop.

purpose.description: What the app does, in one line of at most 80 characters.

use_when.description: Plain phrases of what someone asks for when this recipe fits, e.g. ["online shop", "sell products", "checkout"]. karni recipes list --match ranks recipes by the words a request shares with them.

usually_changed.description: What people usually change in the spec after starting from it, in plain words, e.g. ["the product fields", "the currency"].

version.description: The recipe's own version, e.g. 1.0.0, recorded when a project adds it and compared by karni recipes upgrade. Default: karni-cli's version.

requires.description: Core contracts and modules the recipe needs, each with an optional version range: ["people>=1", "events>=1", "storage"]. Adding the recipe switches each contract on and lists each module.

conflicts.description: Recipes and modules the recipe cannot share a project with.

routes.description: The React pages of the recipe's files and their paths: the first karni build registers each in frontend/src/routes.tsx.
